ELD - HOS & IFTA

ELD compliance, HOS visibility, and IFTA reporting in one workflow.

TTMS helps fleets stay compliant every day with automated duty status logs, HOS violation prevention, and fuel-tax-ready IFTA reports. Drivers, dispatchers, and owners get one reliable compliance timeline for audits, roadside inspections, and internal reviews.

  • Automatic duty status capture

  • Real-time HOS clocks and alerts

  • DVIR and pre-trip inspection logs

  • IFTA mileage and fuel tax summaries

  • Roadside inspection mode

  • Audit-ready compliance reports
